decisions.decision: Remove the seven CREATE TABLE definitions from docs/mbe_schema.sql
decisions.why: Keeps the live-schema derivation as dump+migrations with no third input and no hand-maintained list; both standing checks currently pass against a schema with seven tables the deployment lacks, which is a check that has stopped measuring
decisions.rejected: Recording the drop as a migration here (re-states a change another repo owns, ruled out by the issue, breaks SC-008); an exclusion list in the two checks (a hand-maintained list of exactly the shape #112 was)

decisions.why: _write_privileges_from already removes rows naming an object the enum does not define — the loop written for objects 70/104/105. Removing the enum members is simultaneously the fix and the cleanup, and honours the constraint that this repo deletes no privilege rows
decisions.rejected: A one-off cleanup migration or script (nothing to clean: mbe_dev has zero rows for the four); filtering the four at the write site (a special case in the one function that has none)

decisions.decision: Delete the four enum members rather than keeping them unused
decisions.why: Their access_privilege rows and their screens are both gone, so keeping the members would re-create four rows per account forever for menu entries that do not exist
decisions.rejected: Mirroring EXCLUDE_PRICE_RANGE_VALIDATION=102, kept unused by spec 015 — correct there because its rows still exist, wrong here because these were deleted; renumbering to close the gaps (would re-point stored grants keyed on those numbers)

decisions.decision: Delete the models and correct the dump in one task (the quiet order)
decisions.why: Decided at the review-plan gate. A red commit on the branch cannot be bisected through and its on-purpose-ness does not survive the author forgetting; the evidence the loud order bought is taken separately by local mutation instead
decisions.rejected: Correct the dump first and leave the models briefly unmapped — fails loudly and accurately, proving the check is live, but leaves one red commit in history

decisions.decision: Rebuilt test_merge_remaps_the_referencing_column_not_a_column_named_product on a synthetic reference instead of deleting it
decisions.why: service_order_detail.spare_part was the only table in the schema pointing at product through a differently-named column, so dropping it left the property with no witness though its code path is live; a patch on referencing_columns exercises the interpolation under test
decisions.rejected: Deleting the test with its example (SC-007 permits it, but silently loses a #112-era guard); adding a fixture table to Base.metadata (global — it would appear in every integration database)

decisions.decision: Removed docs/specs/08-technical-service.md, the TechnicalServiceRequestType constant, and the four object rows from docs/constants.md and docs/specs/12-users.md
decisions.why: Discovered during T012 SC-009 verification: the plan listed 12 files and missed these, which described the retired modules as live and would have made SC-009 false
decisions.rejected: Marking them retired in place rather than removing (the catalogs already represent an absent object by omission, e.g. 31)
